english: Scooting collects Ammo Bricks within 12.7 meters, and also picks up Gambit and Pale Heart Motes and Crests. It also grants 25 Handling and Reload Speed for 10 seconds.

source.text:
2 Piece | Scoot to Loot

Upon scooting:
Pick ups Ammo Bricks within 12.7 meters. Will also pick up Gambit/Pale Heart Motes and Crests.
+25 Handling and +25 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.
